_comment: Sized to the token caches actually built (scripts/check_mix.py, 2026-08-26): web 8.31B, en 0.20B, math 0.16B, code 0.08B, chat 0.04B. The main-phase weights are deliberately LOW for the small domains: the epoch cap is shared across both phases, so a main weight large enough to exhaust it leaves the anneal with nothing -- the first version of this file gave math 8% of the main phase and 28% of the anneal, and check_mix showed math/anneal capped to 0 rows, which is the whole point of the anneal defeated. Each small domain now spends about half its epoch budget in the main phase and keeps the rest for the anneal.
